scenario_description:
Objective: Make a temporary card-linked fuel credit usable for a planned diesel top-off without changing the refuel plan or payment method.
Emerging Need: Early notice only suggests possible marina offers; later records align a Foss Harbor refuel, exact opt-in terms, and confirmation that the pump will be usable tomorrow.
Decision Context: The saved rewards profile supplies the existing account, linked-card constraint, and no-new-card preference needed to treat any useful step as a reversible offer activation or documentation choice.
Consequence: Timely attention could yield a small statement credit; ignoring it leaves the refuel and ordinary costs unchanged, while after opt-ins close the purchase earns only standard rewards.

parameter.subject: This week's marina fuel-credit watchlist
parameter.body: Partner marinas around Puget Sound may release short opt-in card-linked fuel credits later this week. No Foss Harbor offer is live yet; wait for a dock-specific notice before relying on any activation.

parameter.title: Diesel top-off before shakedown
parameter.description: Stop at Foss Harbor fuel dock before the 10:00 engine shakedown; use the ordinary personal fuel card if the dock is open.

parameter.subject: Foss Harbor $14 diesel credit open until 12:30 today
parameter.body: A Foss Harbor fuel-dock card-linked offer is now live for existing DriftSaver members: opt in by 12:30 PM today, then make one fuel purchase at Foss Harbor on July 30 to receive a $14 statement credit. Offer activation cannot be added retroactively at the register.

parameter.content: FYI from the Foss fuel dock office: tomorrow's diesel pump is open 7:30-9:30 despite the hose work, but the clerk said they cannot add DriftSaver opt-ins at the pump.

parameter.subject: Foss Harbor fuel-credit opt-in queue closed
parameter.body: The 12:30 PM opt-in window for the Foss Harbor July 30 fuel credit has closed. Accounts not activated before the deadline are not eligible for the $14 credit; regular DriftSaver points still apply to future fuel purchases.
